data.narrative:
Riverlane is a Series C quantum computing company founded by Steve Brierley that has raised $120M+ to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 comparables: 3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Stage-progression methodology is the sole applicable valuation technique. Using total raised ($120M) as a base proxy and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C to subsequent-stage progression yields $204M. This method is grounded in observed step-up patterns across venture stages. Peer-median triangulation does not apply due to insufficient narrow comparables at the same stage or adjacent stages within quantum computing; while five same-sector peers exist, none of the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters yielded three or more datapoints required for robust median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $173M (low) to $235M (high), with a median of $204M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty given reliance on stage-progression alone and the fragmented peer set in quantum computing. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the 1.7x step-up multiplier to Riverlane's specific profile and capital deployment trajectory, as well as the rapidly evolving technical and commercial risk profile of the quantum sector relative to traditional venture benchmarks.
